If any rate is still 0, `make demo` falls back to example_rates_usd_per_mtok and prints a loud EXAMPLE-PRICES banner so no number is mistaken for real.

example_rates_usd_per_mtok._comment: ILLUSTRATIVE placeholders ONLY — not real Claude prices, do not cite. They exist so the demo prints a plausible dollar figure out of the box. Relative shape is the point: reads are far cheaper than fresh input, writes are dearer, 1h writes dearer than 5m.
